name: Thyatira

related_people.name: Jezebel
related_people.role: Christ's name for the false prophetess tolerated in the church here

related_people.name: Lydia
related_people.role: a dealer in this city's purple cloth, converted under Paul's preaching at Philippi

description: Lydia, the dealer in purple cloth converted at Philippi, was originally from Thyatira (Acts 16:14); the city's own church is later addressed in Revelation and rebuked for tolerating a false prophetess (Revelation 2:18-29).
